name: get_market_snapshot
description: Returns top N cryptocurrency futures sorted by technical market anomalies (RVOL, Funding Rate, OI Change, nATR). Eliminates raw OHLCV arrays to optimize LLM context.

limit.description: Maximum number of coins to return (1-20).

name: get_ta_consensus
description: Provides aggregated technical analysis consensus across multiple timeframes including CVD slope, EMA distances, and major liquidation clusters without raw candles.

coin.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL, or BTCUSDT).

name: create_alert
description: Registers an in-memory high-frequency alert condition in the C++ engine. Pushes an event to wake up the sleeping agent when triggered, eliminating continuous API polling.

ttl_minutes.description: Time-To-Live in minutes (1 to 1440). Alert auto-expires after this duration.
